action: standing idle, breathing, ponytail swaying
prompt: Slightly elevate shoulders and expand the chest to simulate a shallow intake of breath. Simultaneously, allow the ponytail to drift backward with a gentle, rhythmic arc, then settle back into the initial resting position as the chest descends.

action: straightening the open jacket and vest by tugging both lapels
prompt: Grasp both lapels firmly near the chest. Pull downward with a sharp, synchronized motion to smooth the fabric against the torso, then quickly release the edges and let the hands drop back to the sides to settle.

action: getting into a low fighting stance with both open hands raised in front of the chest
prompt: Drop into a crouch while shifting weight onto bent knees. Simultaneously sweep both arms upward, bringing open palms to hover before the chest, and settle into a stable, low combat stance with a focused, alert posture.

action: fighting stance idle, bouncing lightly on the knees with open hands raised in front of the chest
prompt: Slightly compress the knees to build momentum, then spring upward to shift weight while lifting the hands to chest height. Flex the palms open with fingers spread, then return to the starting posture to complete the rhythmic cycle.

action: drawing a submachine gun from the shoulder into both hands
prompt: Reach back to the shoulder to grip the submachine gun, pull it forward with a sharp, fluid motion, and snap both hands onto the weapon grip and barrel to stabilize, settling into a ready firing stance.

action: walking forward
prompt: Shift weight forward to lift the rear foot, swinging it past the stationary leg with a firm stride. Land on the heel, rolling through to the toes while the arms swing naturally, then bring the feet back together into a standing stance.

action: running forward
prompt: Lean forward into a stride, driving the lead knee high while pushing off the rear foot. Swing the arms in rhythmic opposition to build momentum, maintaining a low center of gravity before resetting to the starting stance.

action: short jump straight up in place
prompt: Compress the knees and core to wind up, then explode upward into a vertical leap. Reach the peak extension with toes pointed and arms tucked, then descend with controlled impact, bending the knees to absorb the landing and settle into the starting stance.

action: jumping forward from a fighting stance
prompt: Crouch briefly to build tension, then spring forward into a mid-air tuck. Extend the legs fully at the peak of the arc, follow through with a forceful landing, and settle back into a stable, balanced stance.

action: running long jump forward
prompt: Sprint forward, then launch into a powerful leap with knees tucked high toward the chest. Extend the legs fully to reach the peak of the arc, absorb the landing impact with a deep crouch, and rise back to a standing position.

action: palm heel strike upward to the chin with the lead hand
prompt: Drive the lead palm upward in a forceful, snapping arc toward the chin. Maintain a rigid arm throughout the thrust, allowing the torso to twist slightly for leverage before snapping the hand back to a guard position.

action: forearm shove at chest height with the rear arm, hips turning
prompt: Drive the rear forearm forward at chest level with sharp momentum, pivoting the hips and shoulders to generate power. Snap the arm into full extension, allow the shoulder to follow through, then recoil the limb to return to the neutral stance.

action: push kick with the sole of the front foot at stomach height, then one step back
prompt: Drive the lead foot forward into a sharp, thrusting push kick at stomach height, extending the leg fully. Retract the foot with snap, plant it firmly on the ground, and step back to return to the balanced standing stance.

action: stepping in and striking forward at head height with the butt of a submachine gun held in both hands
prompt: Advance with a sharp stride, pivoting the torso to thrust the submachine gun forward with both hands. Drive the stock into the target at head height, follow through with a brief, rigid extension, and recoil back to the starting stance.

action: sliding feet first along the floor with the lead leg extended low
prompt: Slide forward abruptly with the lead leg extended low and the trailing leg tucked, momentum carrying the torso into a low, horizontal posture. Drag the heels along the floor, then pull the knees inward to plant both feet firmly and return to standing.

action: mid-air stomp kick downward and forward with both feet
prompt: Launch upward into a tuck, thrust both feet downward and forward with forceful momentum, and extend legs fully for a heavy impact. Recoil from the force, retract the knees toward the torso, and land firmly back on the ground.

action: aiming a submachine gun at the shoulder and firing two shots with recoil
prompt: Raise the submachine gun to shoulder height, bracing firmly. Trigger two rapid bursts, allowing the barrel to kick upward with each discharge, then sharply stabilize the weapon and return to the original aiming position.

action: two short steps backward keeping the hands up
prompt: Retract the leading foot, then step backward with the trailing foot while keeping the hands raised at chest level. Shift weight onto the rear heel with a slight torso lean to stabilize, then plant the feet firmly to return to the starting posture.

action: blocking with both forearms raised to cover the head, knees bent
prompt: Bend knees deeply while snapping both forearms upward to form a tight guard before the face. Hinge elbows sharply to lock the protective barrier, then extend the legs slightly to absorb the impact before settling back into a braced, defensive stance.

action: getting hit in the chest and recoiling back
prompt: Jolt backward sharply as a heavy impact strikes the torso, causing the shoulders to hunch and the torso to arch. Follow through with a staggered, unsteady retreat before planting the feet firmly to regain a balanced, upright posture.

action: knocked backward off the feet and landing flat on the back
prompt: Jolt upward and backward, lifting heels off the ground as momentum carries the torso into a horizontal arch. Impact the floor with the entire spine, splaying arms and legs outward before settling into a flat, motionless sprawl.

action: getting up from lying on the back into a fighting stance
prompt: Push off the ground with hands, snapping the torso upward into a crouch. Drive the hips forward to transition into a balanced stance, tightening the core and raising fists to chest height with a sharp, controlled follow-through.

action: stunned, wobbling
prompt: Sway the torso and head back and forth with loose, uneven momentum. Stagger the feet slightly while maintaining a heavy, unbalanced stance, then settle into a slumped, glassy-eyed posture.

action: scanning the surroundings by turning the upper body left, right and up
prompt: Rotate the torso to look toward the background, then pivot the upper body to gaze across the foreground. Shift the head upward to survey the area above, then settle the torso and head back into the neutral standing position.

action: aiming a submachine gun tightly at the shoulder and leaning forward to charge a shot
prompt: Raise the submachine gun to the shoulder with a firm grip. Lean the torso forward to brace against the recoil, tighten the core, and tense the stance to focus the aim. Stabilize the weapon, then settle into a rigid, ready-to-fire posture.

action: firing one heavy shot from a submachine gun with strong recoil pushing the shoulder back
prompt: Brace shoulders and extend arms forward to fire a single heavy shot, absorbing intense kinetic recoil that jerks the upper torso backward. Snap the weapon upward sharply before settling back into a stable, rigid firing stance.

action: dropping to one knee, reloading a submachine gun, aiming and firing a burst
prompt: Drop to one knee while bringing the weapon into a firing stance. Slide the magazine into the housing with a sharp click, rack the slide, and steady the grip. Discharge a short burst, then settle back into a stable, alert aiming pose.

action: eating a small bite of food with the right hand
prompt: Raise the hand to the mouth in a swift, controlled arc. Pause momentarily to simulate taking a small bite, then lower the hand back to the side with a natural, fluid follow-through to return to the standing posture.

action: kneeling on one knee to pick something up from the floor and standing up
prompt: Lower the torso to plant one knee firmly on the ground, reaching down to grasp the object. Transition upward with a fluid push from the planted leg, extending the spine to regain a balanced, upright posture.

action: turning the head and upper body toward the viewer to listen
prompt: Pivot the shoulders and rotate the head sharply toward the front. Hold the posture briefly with a focused gaze to indicate intent, then settle back into the original position with a subtle shift in weight.

action: talking while pointing forward with the right index finger
prompt: Extend the arm forward with a sharp index finger point, then pull the elbow back slightly to emphasize the gesture. Simultaneously, tilt the chin downward and open the mouth rhythmically to simulate speech before returning to a neutral standing pose.

action: nodding once
prompt: Lower the chin sharply toward the chest, then snap the head back up to the starting position. Maintain a stiff posture throughout the movement to emphasize the sudden, controlled dip and immediate return to stillness.

action: shaking the head once
prompt: Rotate the head rapidly to one side, then snap it back with a sharp, crisp motion. Maintain a stiff posture throughout the movement, finishing with the head perfectly aligned and still.

action: getting angry, shoulders dropping and right hand clenching into a fist
prompt: Hunch shoulders forward while tensing the torso to project sudden irritation. Pull the arm inward to snap the fingers into a tight, trembling fist, then hold the posture with rigid, shallow breaths before relaxing back into the neutral stance.

action: spotting an enemy and snapping into a fighting stance
prompt: Snap the head forward to focus intensely, then pivot the torso and bend the knees sharply to plant the feet in a wide, stable stance. Raise the arms into a defensive guard with fists clenched, settling into a rigid, alert posture.

action: startled, taking a half step back with the right hand moving to the right hip
prompt: Jolt the torso upward with a sharp intake of breath. Retract the lead foot into a shallow step back while sweeping the hand to the hip. Settle the weight onto the rear heel with a stiff, alert posture.

action: pleased, shoulders loosening and one small nod
prompt: Relax the shoulders downward with a soft, fluid exhale. Tilt the head forward into a concise, deliberate nod before returning to a neutral, upright posture with a subtle, satisfied expression.
